method: Sequential Release native swap-chain captures, frozen extraction, VSync off, 32 warmups and 128 timed samples. Admissions included; two independent processes per source. This cohort predates deferred control uploads and per-frame event pumping.
limitations: Seven CPU distributions exceed the 15 percent matched gate.
Four final pixel hashes and instance draw counts match master.
GPU reductions do not establish a sustained speedup; scheduling and upload stalls need renewed measurement.
Later local optimization changes have no qualified clean-source cohort yet.
No manual art golden or live 60 FPS qualification.

comparison.interpretation: Percent changes are observed variance/trends. Paired runs and repeated cohorts are required before attributing a regression. GPU subsets have explicit counts; software and changed settings cannot satisfy a hardware gate.
